findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_entries, get_image_upload_url · Private data: search_entries, list_entries, analyze_entries, get_image_upload_url, create_entry · Public sink: get_image_upload_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_entries, get_image_upload_url · Private data: search_entries, list_entries, analyze_entries, get_image_upload_url, create_entry · Public sink: get_image_upload_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
